blocks.html:
Avery Decals for 360 Demolition’s Pickup, Chevy Silverado

Vehicle branding is proven to be multiple times more effective in brand recognition than any other traditional advertising technique. A branded company car can form 60,000+ visual responses per day in a major city. This is why our client 360 Demolition chose us to install decals and lettering on their Chevy Silverado.

360 Demolition is a selective interior demolition company that regularly receives positive feedback from its clientele. To broaden their reach, they decided to take the steps to increase their brand visibility. After a consulting session with our graphic designers, they decided on decals with strategic placement of their company logos, website, and contact information on the right side and back of their company truck, a Chevy Silverado. The colour of the decals was picked from Avery Dennison, a striking forest green inspired by their motto “Building a Greener Tomorrow“. If you would like to know more about 360 Demolition and their services, don’t forget to check out their Instagram.

Our installers took over the process for the application. The installation was done in less than 48 hours. Our quick turnaround resulted in the shortest downtime possible in 36o Demolition’s services.

Like 360 Demolition, if you own a business, and want to increase your brand visibility and the size of your clientele by simply driving around in the city, Vinyl Wrap Toronto is the one-stop shop for you.

To check out our previous projects and get inspired for your next car wrap, go to our Portfolio. To check out out other truck wraps, click here.

Get a Free Quote by filling out the form and our team will get back to you as soon as possible.

You can also visit us at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 or call us at 416-746-1381 to get an estimated truck wrap cost.

Don’t forget to follow us on Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, and Pinterest to hear about our special deals, creative wrap projects, and vehicle branding.
